name: Audio player
summary: Play an audio file in place: play and pause, a seek bar with current and total time, mute and volume, with a compact one-row layout for a narrow side panel or a table row.
highlights: Play, seek, time, mute and volume around one audio element
Compact: one 56px row for a 300px panel or a table row; any width under 400px does the same
play, pause, ended, timeupdate and volumechange events
lead: ONE custom element, <aha-audio-player>, defined once and imported unchanged by React, Vue 3 and Vue 2: the DS replacement for a native <audio controls>, whose look changes per browser and cannot be themed. It wraps one <audio> in its shadow root and is built from DS parts: a secondary icon-only <aha-button> to play and pause (secondary, as a list of players holds no primary), an <aha-slider> to seek (its value label shows the time), the current and total time, a tertiary icon-only <aha-button> to mute and a second <aha-slider> for volume. From 400px wide the title sits above one row of controls; with `compact`, or in any box under 400px, it is one 56px row: play, the title over "0:12 / 3:05", the seek bar, mute and a 40px volume slider, the same layout as <aha-audio-track>. `track-title` shows the file name and names the group for a screen reader. Events are composed CustomEvents on the host (play, pause, ended, timeupdate, volumechange); the sliders' own input and change events stay inside.
codeNote: Native <audio controls> → <aha-audio-player>: src → src · the file name → track-title (not title: the global title attribute would show a browser tooltip over the whole player) · muted → muted (initial) or the muted property · audio.volume / currentTime / duration / paused / play() / pause() → the same properties and methods on the element · events play, pause, ended, timeupdate (detail { currentTime, duration }) and volumechange (detail { volume, muted }) fire on the host, composed and bubbling. Keyboard: Tab reaches play, seek, mute and volume in that order; Enter or Space plays and pauses, and mutes; the arrow keys seek by one second (Page Up / Page Down a tenth of the track, Home / End the start and end) and change the volume. Translate the labels with play-label, pause-label, mute-label, unmute-label, seek-label and volume-label. One player plays at a time is the consumer's job: on play, call pause() on the others. React 18: listen with ref.current.addEventListener, since React 18 does not wire CustomEvents; React 19 can use the element directly. Vue binds it natively (@play, @timeupdate). Vue 2 apps import '@ahaslides-product/design/aha-audio-player' and add aha-audio-player to the app's list of DS elements.

spec.label: Box
spec.value: white (bg-container), 1px #E3E3E3 (border-default) border, radius 8, padding 12; fills the width it is given

spec.label: Title
spec.value: track-title above the controls: 14/22 semibold #1A1A1A, one line with an ellipsis, 8px below; hidden when empty

spec.label: One row (400px and up)
spec.value: play (secondary icon-only sm Button, 28px) · current time · seek Slider (fills) · total time · mute (tertiary icon-only sm Button) · volume Slider 80px; 8px gaps, items centred

spec.label: Compact (one row)
spec.value: `compact`, or a box under 400px: one row, 56px minimum, padding 8 and no border: play · the title (14/22 semibold, ellipsis) over current / total time (12/18) · seek Slider (40px minimum) · mute · volume Slider 40px; 12px gaps so the slider thumbs clear the text; the same layout as <aha-audio-track>

spec.label: Time
spec.value: 12/18 #616161 (text-tertiary), tabular numbers, m:ss (h:mm:ss from an hour); 0:00 until the file's length is known

spec.label: Seek
spec.value: the Slider from 0 to the duration in seconds, step 1; its value label shows the time while dragging, on hover and on keyboard focus; disabled until the length is known and with no src

spec.label: Volume
spec.value: the Slider from 0 to 100 percent; it shows 0 while muted, and moving it above 0 unmutes. Mute swaps the speaker glyph (system-speaker-simple-high / system-speaker-simple-slash); unmuting at volume 0 sets the volume to 100%

spec.label: Play
spec.value: system-play, then system-pause while playing; disabled with no src. The host carries a `playing` attribute while it plays

props.name: src
props.desc: The audio file. Changing it loads the new file; removing it stops playback and disables the controls

props.name: track-title
props.desc: The file name or track title shown above the controls and used as the group's accessible name ("Audio player" without it)

props.name: compact
props.desc: The one-row layout for a narrow side panel or a table row; a box under 400px wide uses it anyway

props.name: muted
props.desc: Start muted; the muted property reads and sets it after that

props.name: currentTime / duration / paused
props.desc: The playback position in seconds (settable), the length in seconds (0 until known) and whether it is paused

props.name: play() / pause()
props.desc: Start and pause playback; play() returns a promise that never rejects (a blocked autoplay just stays paused)

props.name: play-label / pause-label / mute-label / unmute-label / seek-label / volume-label
props.default: Play / Pause / Mute / Unmute / Seek / Volume

props.name: play / pause / ended
props.desc: Composed and bubbling; fire when playback starts, pauses and reaches the end

props.name: timeupdate
props.desc: Composed and bubbling; fires as the position moves, about four times a second while playing, and after a seek

props.name: volumechange
props.desc: Composed and bubbling; fires when the volume or mute changes

whenToUse.when: play one audio file in place: a slide's background audio in the editor panel, an uploaded recording
a list of tracks to choose from, each with a short preview (the audio upload modal's Existing tracks)

opinion.note: Use the player for a file the user has already chosen, and give it the file name. Never show a native <audio controls>: it looks different in every browser and ignores the DS. Only one player plays at a time; pause the others on play.
opinion.dsv3: NEW — the DS had no audio player; consumers used the native <audio controls>.

snippets.note: The native form: a version-pinned CDN import and plain HTML, no build step.
